  def sync!

  def record_failure!(error)
    increment(:attempts)
    if attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS
      update!(status: :failed, failed_at: Time.current, last_error: error.message)
    else
      update!(status: :retrying, last_error: error.message)
    end
  end

  def retry!
    update!(status: :pending, attempts: 0, failed_at: nil)
    OrderSyncJob.perform_later(id)
  end

class OrderSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :shopify

  retry_on ShopifyClient::RateLimited, wait: :polynomially_longer, attempts: 3

  def perform(order_sync_id)
    sync = OrderSync.find(order_sync_id)
    sync.sync!
  rescue ShopifyClient::Error => e
    sync.record_failure!(e)
    if sync.retrying?
      self.class.set(wait: backoff(sync.attempts)).perform_later(sync.id)
    end
    Sentry.capture_exception(e) if sync.failed?
  end
